learningObjectives: Understand the basic behavior of common supervised algorithms.
Select an appropriate supervised learning algorithm for a problem.

activities.title: Classification or Regression
activities.instruction: Identify whether each prediction problem is classification or regression.

content.concept: Classification predicts discrete categories, while regression predicts continuous numerical values.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Predict whether a customer will leave → Classification
Predict whether an image contains a cat → Classification
config.answer: Predict whether a customer will leave → Classification

activities.title: Match Algorithms to Problems
activities.instruction: Match each supervised learning algorithm with a suitable use case.

content.concept: Different supervised algorithms make different assumptions and can be useful for different prediction tasks.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: Linear Regression → Predict a continuous numerical value
Logistic Regression → Predict a binary class
Decision Tree → Make rule-based classification or regression predictions
K-Nearest Neighbors → Predict using nearby training examples
config.answer: Linear Regression → Predict a continuous numerical value

activities.title: Explore Decision Boundaries
activities.instruction: Adjust the classification setting and observe how the decision boundary changes.

content.concept: A classification model uses a decision boundary to separate observations into predicted classes.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Build a Supervised Model
activities.instruction: Assemble the main stages of a supervised learning workflow.

content.concept: Supervised learning uses labeled data to train a model that can make predictions for new observations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
